decisions: T1 to T3 are applied to the sample's Actual block before the recalculation, so LibreOffice computes every cached value, the Actual subtotals included; the ledger extract is written from the unmodified model in ledger sign (debit positive).
The clean workbook carries none of the planted faults, T1 to T3 included: its Actual block matches the ledger exactly.

planted.fault: A typed number inside a formula row
planted.control: Formula integrity: a typed constant in a row that is otherwise formulas.
planted.why_only_this_control: Labels, units and headers are unchanged (structure); every formula keeps its cached value (calculation state); the EBIT and FY2026 formulas use the typed figure, so totals recomputed from the extracted cells agree (totals); nothing is hidden or linked.

planted.fault: A total whose range stops one month short
planted.control: Totals: the FY2026 cell is 591,840 short of the sum of its twelve months.
planted.why_only_this_control: The FY2026 column is not part of the month pattern and its formula holds no numeric constant (formula integrity); EBIT's FY2026 cell sums EBIT's own months, so no other total moves; nothing else changes.

planted.fault: A hidden row holding a manual override
planted.label: Manual override: Forecast marketing
planted.control: Hidden content and links: a hidden row.
planted.why_only_this_control: The row is outside every block's defined name, so the extractor never reads it (structure, formula integrity, totals); it holds a typed number and no formula refers to it (calculation state).

planted.fault: An embedded constant inside a formula
planted.control: Formula integrity: one break with two reasons, an embedded constant and a difference from the pattern of its row.
planted.why_only_this_control: The cells that depend on it (Marketing, Gross profit, EBIT and the FY2026 totals) keep their own patterns and use its cached value, so totals agree; nothing is hidden, linked or out of structure.

planted.fault: A hidden sheet holding numbers nothing refers to
planted.control: Hidden content and links: a hidden sheet.
planted.why_only_this_control: It is not a plan sheet (structure checks the required tabs, and a Plan_ sheet for each entity on Lists); it holds typed numbers only and nothing refers to it.

planted.fault: A late journal: the ledger has an amount the workbook's Actual block lacks
planted.why_only_this_control: The Actual block's subtotals and FY2026 totals are formulas, so the workbook still agrees with itself: no spreadsheet control fires.

planted.fault: A reclassification: one amount in one account in the workbook and another in the ledger
planted.control: Reconcile: one possible reclassification (two equal and opposite differences in one entity and month).
planted.why_only_this_control: Both accounts are operating expenses, so the formula subtotals move together and the workbook agrees with itself.

planted.fault: A missing entity-month: the Actual block has no figures, the ledger does
planted.control: Reconcile: one missing entity-month, not one break per account.
planted.why_only_this_control: The header for the month stays, so there is no gap in periods; the subtotal formulas give zero and the totals agree.
